# TG Movies

> TG Movies is an independent cinema journal providing genuine movie reviews, box office collection analysis, upcoming OTT release schedules, and entertainment industry news.

## Key Sections
- [Home](https://tgmovies.in/): Latest publications, trending movie news, and editorial highlights.
- [Bollywood](https://tgmovies.in/category/bollywood): In-depth reviews and box office reports from Hindi cinema.
- [Hollywood](https://tgmovies.in/category/hollywood): Global blockbuster reviews, festival premieres, and franchise updates.
- [South Cinema](https://tgmovies.in/category/south-cinema): Coverage of Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam, and Kannada film industries.
- [OTT Releases](https://tgmovies.in/category/ott-releases): Weekly streaming release calendars across Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+ Hotstar, and JioCinema.
- [Web Series](https://tgmovies.in/category/web-series): Reviews and season breakdowns of trending streaming shows.
- [Movie Reviews](https://tgmovies.in/category/movie-reviews): Editorial reviews and star ratings.

## Feeds & Sitemaps
- [RSS Feed](https://tgmovies.in/rss.xml): Real-time XML syndication feed of newly published articles.
- [Sitemap](https://tgmovies.in/sitemap-index.xml): Full XML sitemap index.

## Editorial Policy
- Factual release dates, verified star cast details, and objective critical analysis.
- Zero fake metrics and zero sponsored bias without disclosure.
